I wrote `component.html` in the People folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

I followed `DESIGN.md`. Where the Look (v6) section differs from the earlier Screens section, I used Look.

- **Top of the page:** a 6px blue accent bar runs across the full width. Below it, "People" is set in light capitals at 64px. The dark "Add Person" pill sits on the right, and a 2px ink rule runs under the row.
- **Search:** the "Search people" label sits inline to the left of a 44px, 320px field with a 1.5px ink border.
- **List:** it's a flat table with no card around it, with an ink header row and 64px rows. The five people have the names, titles, departments and emails you gave. Names are 18px and semibold, and the emails are `mailto:` links in the accent text colour.
- **Structure and tokens:** everything is inside `<div id="component">` at 1280px, with plain HTML and CSS and no JavaScript. The tokens I used are copied into the file so it stands alone, and no component style uses a raw hex value.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't in the folder, so they fall back to the system sans-serif unless the viewer has them installed. I didn't add any font files.
- **New token:** I added `--text-page: 4rem` for the 64px title, because `DESIGN.md` requires every font size to be a token and none of the existing ones is 64px.
- **Warmth:** I kept to your exact content and added no extra copy, so the welcoming feel comes only from the white space, the blue accent and the rounded pill button.
